mechanics.name: Small Game
mechanics.currentEffect: Within 10/11/12 metres of a Totem, you see its Aura.
activation: Ends/deactivates when: The Totem's Aura is no longer revealed after it leaves the tiered range or no longer exists.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Complete rework: now reveals a Totem's Aura within 10/11/12 metres and removes the former cone, cue, cooldown, and token mechanics.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Nearby Totems reveal their Auras within a tiered radius.

editorial.summary: Simply see the Aura of any Totem within up to 12 metres.
useCases: Find a nearby Hex without sweeping every corner manually.
Support Inner Strength, Overzealous, Counterforce, or Boon builds.
Teach newer players common Totem spawn locations.
counters: Twelve metres is a short detection radius.
Experienced players often know common Totem spawns already.
The perk gives no speed bonus or Killer information.
cons: Map knowledge replaces part of its value.
analysis: Small Game became dramatically simpler in 10.2. The directional cone, audio cue, cooldown, and narrowing-token minigame are gone; a nearby Totem simply reveals its Aura.
That is better for the actual job. If a Hex, Boon setup, or Inner Strength charge matters, the player can search naturally and receive a clear confirmation inside twelve metres.
The range is still small enough that the perk does not solve Totem locations from across the map, and experienced players will often recognize spawn patterns without it.
Small Game is therefore clean beginner and build support rather than meta information. The rework raises usability more than power.
editorial.verdict: Finally simple: walk near a Totem, see the Totem. Good support for Totem builds and new players, not a high-impact general slot.
